answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to the cryptographically attested enclave measurement MRENCLAVE, with remote attestation proving that approved code runs inside genuine protected hardware. Copying keys or duplicating a virtual machine cannot reproduce that hardware-rooted identity; every additional identity requires separately provisioned physical silicon and valid attestation credentials, making Sybil expansion costly. jade, grove, and zephyr are labels only, not identity substitutes.
